attBesluta.text: I’m very happy with my purchase, it is functional and stylish. It fits 2 large litter trays, and my cats love using it.
Für den Preis kann man sich im Hinblick auf Leistung überhaupt nicht beschweren, der Katzenschrank war leicht aufzubauen, kam schnell an und ist qualitativ hochwertig
Ottimo acquisto per mettere le lettiere dei nostri 7 gatti,una stella in meno solo per il tempo di consegna di 2 settimane. Consigliato
Sólido, buena calidad, fácil de montar. Respecto al aislamiento acústico, no es ninguna maravilla. Para el precio que tiene, esperaba más.
Très beau produit, pratique d'utilisation et très facile à monter. Idéal dans local professionnel. La livraison a toutefois pris plus de temps qu'annoncé. Service client réactif aux sollicitations.
Great value for the money. Works fantastic and keeps everything clean! Had over 2 years and looks new still.

I am a 53 year old woman and I put this together by myself, I love Vevor because they send almost everything you need to put it together like a Phillips screw driver and the correct Allen wrench.. It only took about 40 minutes and my husband helped me put it on the washer and dryer. It looks so good.
easy to assemble.Seems to be of decent quality except cloth on drawer coming apart at the seam right out of the box
Super bonitas y súper funcionales. Una calidad estupenda. Sorprendida porque superaron lo que me espera así que, muy contenta.
El pedido llegó antes de la fecha prevista y venía perfectamente embalado. Se ajusta a las medidas y descripción facilitadas por Vevor. Estoy muy contenta con la compra.
Super fijn en mooi Heb hem op me 6 pits gedaan is net iets te smal maar maakt me niks uit ben er blij mee
Könnte noch etwas größer sein aber sieht toll aus.
The best way to create cutting space in a tiny kitchen!
Perfect fit for a five ring hob. Provides extra workspace and is very pleasing to the eye when stove top not in use. Little heavy when having to remove to use hob. Good quality product
Niet geschikt voor bora inductie helaas, Plaat te zwaar, moet op "pootjes" Anders geeft kookplaat alarm Is wel een mooi stuk hout!

We bought this for our bbq shed and it works grat. Easy to assemble..took 2 to 3 hours. Instructions are good. Looks exactly as pictured. We added caster wheels as our design was not availa le with them
This was easy to assemble and set up. I'm not using it as a kitchen island but it will suit my needs perfectly! Well built and would definitely buy again if I had the need.

We had a damaged product and were outside of the 30 day return which prompted me to give a low rating initially; HOWEVER,when I contacted the vendor, they sent a replacement for our damaged island. It looks beautiful! This vendor is very reliable!

Tons of parts so be prepared for a challenging assembly, but the final result is a wonderful kitchen island at a bargain price. All the drawers slide and close well. The trash compartment is solid. One slight issue is the folding shelf doesn't sit completely flush with the top unless you screw the clips really high. And with time, they tend to move so you will have to re-adjust if you're seeking a perfectly flat surface. Easy to clean and beautiful color that seems quite resistant to scratches.
Very impressed with this island. Was easy to assemble and quality is superb.

Ilot de très bel aspect, de qualité très correcte, de plus le fabriquant est très réactif pour vous dépanner, j'avais un rail de tiroir défectueux, il m'en a été renvoyé 6 gratuitement pour réparer le tiroir, excellent service après vente de VEVOR. le montage est facile pour un bricoleur.

Bought a few weeks ago. Excellent delivery time. Ok to put together but should really have black hinges on table extension not white also no covers for the screw heads which can be seen all the time. Nice addition to the kitchen but would not go for the trash bin door again as it is not very stable and doesn't always close.

Took a really long time to put together! Instructions were pretty clear, though. We were missing the pieces that hold the back boards together. We used packing tape & taped them from the inside. Hoping they’ll hold, but not confident. There was a couple damaged pieces, too. Which is why I only gave it 4 stars. One was an inside cabinet piece, but the other was on the bottom edge. It’s nice & heavy and serves the purpose of what I bought it for.
